description: dir on an oct key with alg A128KW and an oct key with alg dir returns the alg dir key; decided by ADR 0054 §2.2 (JWK alg): member 1's alg is exactly dir; member 0's A128KW is neither dir nor a content encryption algorithm, so the §2.2 exception does not apply; both are oct (§2.1), neither has use or key_ops; outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
